checkpoints.description: [1/1] gate raw os.environ[...] reads (P011 R3); rewrite P011 R1-R7: deps per P003 R3 with adapter-local imports, R3 defers to P003 R6, R4 defers to P003 R4, defined interactive opt-in, exit codes, triad format, one end-to-end demo command; ADR-084

impact_assessment.why: R1 contradicts P003 R3; R3/R4 duplicate P003; R7 is a should; hedges
impact_assessment.benefits: one dependency rule, one platform rule; env-read ban checked
impact_assessment.risks: contract: update_knowledge_base exits 1 on raw environ reads; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: AIKit has none; README/help updated; pins

checkpoints.description: [1/1] rewrite P012 R1-R7: split LLM-calling code vs agent duties, one payload limit (16,000 chars), cache structure not outcome, schema-validated replies, named step/token caps, decidable lean-code tests; ADR-085

impact_assessment.why: P012 mixes audiences, uses banned words, states unverifiable outcomes and unspecified K
impact_assessment.benefits: one reading per audience; every limit a number
impact_assessment.risks: contract: rule text only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: pins in shared table; cross-principle ADR line

checkpoints.description: [1/1] rewrite P013 R1-R7 with defined state vs generated files, single numbers (3 retries, 10MB, 3s lock, 30s stale), long-running defined, orphan cleanup = P006 R6 --clean, named fault list pinned by a coverage test; ADR-086

impact_assessment.why: P013 scope undefined (generated writers skip retry), ranges instead of numbers, R6 claims a startup sweep that contradicts P006 R6, R7 outcome claim
impact_assessment.benefits: one reading; rule describes what AIKit does
impact_assessment.risks: contract: rule text only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none

checkpoints.description: [1/1] rewrite P014 R1-R7: behaviour change needs a test that fails without it; define weakening and one exception (user approval + ADR naming the test), P000 R5 points to it; flaky defined; observable-assertion and negative-path tests decidable; ADR-087

impact_assessment.why: P014 R2 and P000 R5 give two different exceptions for loosening a test; weakening undefined; R1/R5/R6 judgement words
impact_assessment.benefits: one rule for when a test may change; decidable test duties
impact_assessment.risks: contract: rule text only (P000 R5 and P014 R2); dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: pins; cross-principle ADR lines for both P000 and P014
